title: Endpoint ACCESS-BARRIER state persistence across a window ladder and the class-conditional validity horizon of a static endpoint denylist
question: On the frozen 57-endpoint credential-free HTTP GET pool (inherited verbatim from EXP-PHYSICS-37992957068; NOT extended because the pre-freeze attainability certificate is satisfied inside the frozen 57), is an endpoint's intrinsic ACCESS-BARRIER state STATIONARY across separated observation windows -- measured as the persistence of the intrinsic classes {BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR} versus the transient rate-driven class RATE_LIMIT_429 and the ordinary classes {CLEAN, UNAVAILABLE_403, OTHER_NONBARRIER} -- and does a static endpoint-level denylist built from an anchor window at T0 retain predictive validity at T0+delta (false-accept = a denylisted endpoint recovers; false-reject = a previously CLEAN endpoint newly blocks) so that the validity horizon and class-conditional re-probe interval of the dead-end policy are ESTIMABLE rather than assumed? The unit is endpoint access-state persistence/timescale, NOT next-request barrier classification (bounded by EXP-PHYSICS-37992957068) and NOT staleness of inherited content (C-FRESHNESS) or Runtime drift controls. The temporal/window axis is measured; the source-vantage axis is a declared single-vantage scope boundary.

hypothesis.H1_stationary: Endpoint ambient access-barrier state is stationary on the tested timescale: STATIONARITY_SKILL(delta_ref) >= 0.05 nats with permutation p < 0.05 and endpoint-clustered CI lower > 0, every intrinsic class present at T0 has CLASS_PERSISTENCE >= 0.90, there is no rate transient and no state-change evidence; a static denylist is then valid through the whole nominal ladder.
hypothesis.H2_nonstationary: Endpoint ambient access-barrier state is NOT stationary on the tested timescale: an intrinsic class present at T0 fails CLASS_PERSISTENCE >= 0.90, or (with no intrinsic class present at T0) ambient transitions or a denylist false-accept/false-reject at delta_ref occur. A merely non-significant stationarity test with NO positive change evidence is NOT H2; it is SIN_INCONCLUSIVE.
hypothesis.H2b_class_conditional: Intrinsic non-rate barriers (BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR) persist (CLASS_PERSISTENCE >= 0.90) while the rate-driven class RATE_LIMIT_429 recovers or appears transiently within the ladder, so validity is class-conditional and the re-probe interval must differ by class.
hypothesis.H0_null: The lag state is independent of the anchor state (exchangeable endpoints), so STATIONARITY_SKILL ~ 0 and a static denylist is no better than a constant usable-endpoint prior.
hypothesis.relation_to_claim: H1/H2/H2b are orthogonal falsifiable programs on the C-WEB-DYNAMICS next_gate axis 'timescales'. H2/H2b bound (do not reject) a pooled static-denylist prior on this pool/window; no hypothesis advances C-WEB-DYNAMICS above HYPOTHESIS.

falsifier: TWO-SIDED, both directions reachable through the frozen metric and decision logic (pre-freeze branch probe on synthetic worlds: S1, S0, SM and SIN all produced; see prereg.md sections 'Null calibration' and 'Attainability certificate'). Thresholds are frozen: tau_FA = tau_FR = 0.10; alpha = 0.05; delta_SKILL = 0.05 nats; pc_power_min = 0.80; nc_false_positive_max = 0.05; intrinsic_persistence_min = 0.90; min_t0_barrier = 3; delta_ref actual >= 1500 s. Definitions: STAT_SIG_SIGONLY = STATIONARITY_SKILL(delta_ref) >= 0.05 AND permutation p < 0.05 AND clustered CI lower > 0. INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT = at least one class in {BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR} is present at T0 AND every present class in that set has CLASS_PERSISTENCE >= 0.90. INTRINSIC_BREAK = (an intrinsic class is present at T0) AND NOT INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT. RATE_TRANSIENT = (STRESS_FALSE_ACCEPT > 0.10) OR (median TRANSIENT_RECOVERY_HALF_LIFE finite and < 1800) OR (a RATE_LIMIT_429 endpoint is present at T0 and CLASS_PERSISTENCE[RATE_LIMIT_429] < 0.90) OR (AMBIENT_RECOVERY_n > 0) OR (STRESS_ONSET_n > 0). STATE_CHANGE_EVIDENCE = (AMBIENT_RECOVERY_n > 0) OR (AMBIENT_ONSET_n > 0) OR (DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT(delta_ref) > 0.10) OR (DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT(delta_ref) > 0.10).

B_EXCHANGE.description: Mandated memory/constant null: a GLOBAL uniform shuffle of the lag barrier labels B_delta across all endpoints (10000 permutations, seed 38074818597), preserving the anchor marginals, recomputing I(B_0;B_delta). This is exactly the null that the anchor state carries no information about the lag state beyond its marginal (identity-transfer == constant-marginal).

B_CONSTANT_USABLE.description: No-denylist baseline: predict non-barrier for every endpoint at every lag. Reference for the secondary DENYLIST_SKILL log-loss improvement.

B_MARGINAL.description: Predict the lag class from the lag-period marginal class frequency.

B_LASTSWEEP.description: Predict the next rung from the immediately preceding rung rather than from the anchor (re-probe interval diagnostic only).

baselines.comparison: STATIONARITY_SKILL is measured against B_EXCHANGE; DENYLIST_SKILL against B_CONSTANT_USABLE; B_MARGINAL and B_LASTSWEEP are reported diagnostics.

PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY.description: Offline planted-stationary generator: N=57; anchor state Bernoulli(f_b); lag state equals the anchor with probability rho, else redrawn Bernoulli(f_b). The SAME plug-in MI + B_EXCHANGE permutation test is applied.
PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY.power_requirement: Fraction of R replications with permutation p < 0.05 must be >= 0.80.
PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY.construct_boundary: Validates that the estimator recovers a known stationary endpoint population at this n; it does not assert that any real endpoint is stationary. Weak-but-real persistence (MI ~ 0.05 nats) is only ~0.6-powered at n=57, which is why a non-significant MI is treated as ambiguity (SIN), not as non-stationarity.

PC_ORACLE_BARRIER.description: Live positive control on non-pool hosts with deterministic status: https://httpbin.org/status/429 and redundant https://httpbingo.org/status/429 must classify RATE_LIMIT_429; https://no-such-host.invalid/ must classify TRANSPORT_ERROR; https://httpbin.org/status/403 must classify UNAVAILABLE_403 (proving 403-as-plain is not read as a challenge block). If both 429 oracles are unreachable/challenged the run is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
PC_ORACLE_BARRIER.pass_condition: Every oracle request classified into its expected class; otherwise MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
PC_ORACLE_BARRIER.construct_boundary: Confirms the live collection+classifier path registers barriers and separates 403-as-block from 403-as-plain; not a natural Web barrier.

NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE.description: Offline exchangeable generator: N=57; anchor and lag binary states drawn independently with the same per-endpoint Bernoulli prevalence. Same estimator and permutation test.
NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE.pass_condition: Fraction of R replications with permutation p < 0.05 must be <= 0.05.
NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE.construct_boundary: A genuinely exchangeable endpoint population must not yield spurious stationarity skill.

NC_CLEAN_ORACLE.description: Live negative control on https://httpbin.org/status/200, https://httpbin.org/uuid and https://example.com/, which must classify CLEAN.
NC_CLEAN_ORACLE.pass_condition: All requests classify CLEAN; otherwise MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
NC_CLEAN_ORACLE.construct_boundary: Confirms the classifier does not fire on clean responses.

C_PROBE_LOAD.description: Validity control for self-induction, NOT a statistical null: Cochran-Armitage trend of ambient barrier prevalence across the 5 sweeps for the 52 non-stressed endpoints, plus the pre-registered STATIONARITY_SKILL_NO_STRESS replica measured on those endpoints. A rising trend CI excluding 0, or a large full-vs-no-stress gap, is disclosed as a self-induction caveat.
C_PROBE_LOAD.construct_boundary: Separates genuine endpoint persistence from accumulation of barriers caused by our own probes.

measurement_validity.target_integrity: Every request stores raw HTTP status, response headers (server, cf-mitigated, retry-after), body SHA-256, byte length, first 262144 body bytes for marker matching, elapsed ms, sweep index, endpoint and any transport error string. The class is a pure deterministic function of those stored fields under the frozen classifier, so AUDIT can recompute it.
measurement_validity.label_determinism: Each sweep's ambient class depends only on that sweep's single response; the load class only on that burst's responses. No class depends on the anchor state, so conditioning on the anchor state does not leak the lag label.
measurement_validity.split_integrity: Anchor = sweep 0; lag labels are sweeps 1..4 at nominal offsets 30/180/720/1800 s. The estimator is a pre-registered closed-form mutual information; exactness is by permutation and clustered bootstrap, not fitting.
measurement_validity.uncertainty_integrity: Endpoint-permutation null: 10000 GLOBAL uniform shuffles of the lag vector across all 57 endpoints (seed 38074818597). Endpoint-clustered bootstrap: cluster = registrable_domain = URL host with a single leading 'www.' stripped and the final two dot-separated labels retained (no multi-label public suffix occurs in the frozen 57); 10000 resamples (seed 38074818597) give percentile 95% CIs.
measurement_validity.sampling_integrity: The 57-endpoint universe is frozen and may not be substituted, added to or dropped. Per-sweep probe ORDER is a frozen seeded permutation (seed 38074818597). No endpoint may be dropped after seeing its outcomes.
measurement_validity.representation_integrity: One stdlib-HTTP client (Python 3.12 standard library only; numpy is NOT required and the bound parent lib is NOT imported), one User-Agent, one network egress vantage, one ~35-minute wall-clock window. The source-vantage axis is NOT varied and is a declared scope boundary.
measurement_validity.control_integrity: PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY power at (f_b=0.20, rho=0.80) >= 0.80; NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE false-positive at p=0.20 <= 0.05; PC_ORACLE_BARRIER and NC_CLEAN_ORACLE live classifications correct. Any failure => status MEASUREMENT_INVALID, never a scientific negative.
measurement_validity.prerequisite_integrity: Live network must reach the frozen universe and both oracle host groups. At T0 the number of ambient-barrier endpoints must be >= 3 (dynamic-range floor); the anchor and delta_ref sweeps must both complete; delta_ref actual delta >= 1500 s. Any shortfall => MEASUREMENT_INVALID (attainability failure). The census certifies that >= 1 and in fact 6 T0 intrinsic endpoints are reachable, but intrinsic presence is a reported/observed floor, not a hard gate: if no intrinsic class is present at T0, the intrinsic-persistence metrics are undefined and the frozen S0 no-intrinsic clause / SIN apply. The >= 3 T0 barrier floor and the anchor/delta_ref completion requirements ARE hard gates.
measurement_validity.power_integrity: Stationarity detection power is REPORTED, not gated: POWER_AT_DELTA_SKILL (power at MI=0.05 nats at f_b_obs), POWER_AT_RHO90 (power at f_b_obs, rho=0.90) and MI_POWER_OK (power at f_b_obs, rho=1.0). No branch depends on a non-significant negative: S0 requires positive change evidence and an ambiguous negative is SIN.
measurement_validity.activity_disclosure: The only pre-freeze activity is non-outcome-bearing: (i) a reachability census on the full frozen 57 in two sweeps ~160 s apart plus a 6-GET/0.12 s burst on the 5 rate-limit-capable endpoints plus a targeted induce-then-cold-probe recovery check (script sha256 recorded in prereg.md); (ii) offline estimator/PC/NC/power/branch calibration and branch reachability on synthetic data only. These establish attainability, classifier liveness, calibration, power and branch reachability only; EXECUTE must re-verify all floors and controls from its own data.

frozen_intrinsic_classifier.CHALLENGE_RE_LITERAL: (?i)(just a moment|cf-browser-verification|cf[-_]chl[-_]|challenge-platform|cf-challenge|cdn-cgi/challenge|attention required|checking your browser|enable javascript and cookies|verify you are human|please complete the security check|g-recaptcha|hcaptcha|recaptcha|cf-turnstile|<title>\s*just a moment)
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.source_of_record: research/physics/exp_37992957068_lib.py CHALLENGE_MARKER_RE (sha256 767e2c56fc0fb79bb953f5f11d1223a4b82305782457eb346a70f94d41e1054f), transcribed verbatim; bound in freeze_artifacts.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.match_scope: CHALLENGE_RE is applied to the first 262144 bytes of the response body decoded as utf-8 with errors ignored. cf-mitigated is lowercased and compared to the string 'challenge'.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.CLEAN: HTTP status in {200,202} and body does not match CHALLENGE_RE.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE: HTTP status == 403 AND (lowercase(cf-mitigated) == 'challenge' OR body matches CHALLENGE_RE).
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.UNAVAILABLE_403: HTTP status == 403 without any challenge marker.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.TRANSPORT_ERROR: No HTTP response (DNS failure, connection refused, TLS failure, or timeout).
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.OTHER_NONBARRIER: Any other HTTP status (404, 500, redirect chains to error) OR a 2xx carrying a challenge marker.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.label_determinism: All classes are functions of a single request's stored fields only; none depends on prior requests.

frozen_universe.source: verbatim endpoints of EXP-PHYSICS-37992957068 (inherited from EXP-PHYSICS-37973239386); used unchanged. EXECUTE may not substitute, add to, or drop endpoints.

sweep_protocol.ambient_probe: For EVERY endpoint: a fresh cookie jar, then exactly one HTTP GET. Store raw fields; ambient_class = classifier output. Endpoints are probed sequentially in a per-sweep frozen seeded permutation order (seed 38074818597) with inter-endpoint gap 0.30 s.
sweep_protocol.load_probe: Immediately AFTER its ambient probe, each endpoint in stratum_stress additionally receives a burst of B_stress=8 GETs at gap 0.15 s inside a SEPARATE fresh cookie jar; load_class = argmax severity_rank over the 8 responses. The 52 non-stress endpoints receive no load probe.
sweep_protocol.sweep_state_definition: The PRIMARY state for all stationarity/denylist metrics is ambient_class. load_class is used only for the transient-class diagnostics.
sweep_protocol.request_headers: Frozen User-Agent 'SPIDER-research2/1.0 (+credential-free access-state persistence probe)' and Accept: */*; GET only; no authentication; no JavaScript.
sweep_protocol.gap_after_probe: 0.30 s between consecutive endpoints within a sweep.

request_policy.note: There is NO retry, so a DNS/connect/TLS/timeout failure is directly TRANSPORT_ERROR. The per_host_requests=2 for oracle controls are two independent observations, not retries.

sweep_protocol.partial_ladder_rule: Analysis labels each sweep by its NOMINAL rung; per-rung metrics use nominal rungs. Actual elapsed deltas are recorded and reported. If the anchor fails entirely or the delta_ref actual delta < 1500 s the run is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

stratum_stress.definition: Fixed pre-registered rate-limit-capable set from parent accepted evidence and the pre-freeze census; NOT selected from this run's outcomes.

stratum_intrinsic_candidates.definition: Fixed pre-registered towards-persistent candidates from parent accepted evidence and the census; reported as a diagnostic subgroup, NOT selected from this run's outcomes.

strata.primary_inference_population: The full frozen 57-endpoint pool for STATIONARITY_SKILL and FA/FR; STATIONARITY_SKILL_NO_STRESS on the 52 non-stressed endpoints is the pre-registered robustness replica.

decision_rule.metric_definition: STATIONARITY_SKILL(delta) = plug-in binary mutual information I(B_anchor;B_delta) in nats/endpoint over the ambient barrier indicator, with a B_EXCHANGE global endpoint-permutation p-value (10000 permutations) and an endpoint-clustered bootstrap 95% CI [LO,HI] (10000 resamples). Higher = more stationary/identity-informative.

primary_decision_quantities.STAT_SIG_SIGONLY: STATIONARITY_SKILL(delta_ref) >= 0.05 AND perm p < 0.05 AND clustered CI lower > 0.
primary_decision_quantities.MI_POWER_OK: power of PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY at (f_b=f_b_obs, rho=1.0, R=200, perms=1000) >= 0.80 (REPORTED only, not a gate).
primary_decision_quantities.INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT: at least one class in {BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR} present at T0 AND every present class in that set has CLASS_PERSISTENCE >= 0.90.
primary_decision_quantities.RATE_TRANSIENT: (STRESS_FALSE_ACCEPT > 0.10) OR (median TRANSIENT_RECOVERY_HALF_LIFE finite and < 1800) OR (a RATE_LIMIT_429 endpoint is present at T0 and CLASS_PERSISTENCE[RATE_LIMIT_429] < 0.90) OR (AMBIENT_RECOVERY_n > 0) OR (STRESS_ONSET_n > 0). Generic ambient onsets are reported (AMBIENT_ONSET_n) but excluded from this gate so a new intrinsic block is not mislabeled transient.
primary_decision_quantities.DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT: FA(delta) = fraction of T0 ambient-barrier endpoints whose ambient class at delta is non-barrier.
primary_decision_quantities.DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT: FR(delta) = fraction of T0 ambient-nonbarrier endpoints whose ambient class at delta is barrier.
primary_decision_quantities.DENYLIST_HORIZON: largest ladder delta delta_k such that FA and FR pass at EVERY lag up to and including delta_k (a contiguous valid prefix); 0 if the first lag already fails.
primary_decision_quantities.DENYLIST_FIRST_FAIL_LAG: smallest ladder delta at which FA > 0.10 or FR > 0.10, else null.
primary_decision_quantities.INTRINSIC_BREAK: (an intrinsic class present at T0) AND NOT INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT.

secondary_quantities.STATIONARITY_SKILL_MULTI: plug-in 6-class mutual information I(C_anchor;C_delta) at delta_ref with the same permutation null.
secondary_quantities.STATIONARITY_SKILL_NO_STRESS: STATIONARITY_SKILL(delta_ref) restricted to the 52 non-stressed endpoints.
secondary_quantities.DENYLIST_SKILL: log-loss improvement (nats/endpoint) of the anchor-transfer predictor over B_CONSTANT_USABLE at delta_ref.
secondary_quantities.CLASS_PERSISTENCE: For each T0 ambient class, the fraction of endpoints with that class whose delta_ref ambient class is identical.
secondary_quantities.TRANSIENT_RECOVERY_HALF_LIFE: For stratum_stress endpoints, the smallest nominal rung at which the ambient class is non-barrier after a T0 load_class in barrier_set; report per-endpoint and median; null if no such endpoint.
secondary_quantities.STRESS_FALSE_ACCEPT: fraction of stratum_stress endpoints with T0 load_class in barrier_set that are ambient-non-barrier at delta_ref; 0.0 when the denominator is empty.
secondary_quantities.C_PROBE_LOAD: Cochran-Armitage trend of ambient barrier prevalence across sweeps for the 52 non-stress endpoints (slope, two-sided p).
secondary_quantities.AMBIENT_ONSET_n / AMBIENT_RECOVERY_n / P: AMBIENT_ONSET_n = consecutive-sweep non-barrier->barrier ambient transitions; AMBIENT_RECOVERY_n = barrier->non-barrier; PERSIST_n = endpoints with identical ambient class at T0 and delta_ref; STRESS_ONSET_n = ambient RATE_LIMIT_429 appearances on stratum_stress endpoints whose T0 ambient class was not RATE_LIMIT_429.
secondary_quantities.POWER_AT_DELTA_SKILL / POWER_AT_RHO90: reported power diagnostics at MI=0.05 nats and at rho=0.90.

branch_precedence: 1. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any measurement_validity prerequisite fails (network unreachable to universe or oracle hosts; classifier not reproducible; PC power < 0.80; NC false-positive > 0.05; an oracle misclassified; fewer than 3 T0 ambient-barrier endpoints; anchor incomplete or delta_ref actual delta < 1500 s).
2. S0_NON_STATIONARY if INTRINSIC_BREAK OR (STATE_CHANGE_EVIDENCE AND no intrinsic class present at T0). Positive non-stationarity evidence.
3. S1_STATIONARY if STAT_SIG_SIGONLY AND INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT AND NOT RATE_TRANSIENT AND NOT STATE_CHANGE_EVIDENCE. DENYLIST_HORIZON = 1800 then follows as a reported consequence, not a gate.
5. SIN_INCONCLUSIVE otherwise (including a non-significant STAT_SIG_SIGONLY with no positive change evidence). NEVER S0.
decision_rule.measurement_invalid_conditions: Network unreachable; classifier non-reproducible; PC power < 0.80 at (f_b=0.20,rho=0.80); NC false-positive > 0.05; an oracle misclassified; fewer than 3 T0 ambient-barrier endpoints; anchor incomplete or delta_ref actual delta < 1500 s. These are attainability/measurement failures and MUST NOT be reported as S0_NON_STATIONARY. Intrinsic presence at T0 is NOT gated: the census certifies 6 reachable T0 intrinsic endpoints, and if none is present at EXECUTE the intrinsic metrics are reported null and S0's no-intrinsic clause (or SIN) applies.
decision_rule.claim_ceiling: At most C-WEB-DYNAMICS = HYPOTHESIS here; H2/S0 and H2b/SM bound (do not reject) a pooled static-denylist prior on this frozen pool/window. No PRODUCT_CORE promotion and no EXPERIMENTAL upgrade from this single window ladder.

product_consequence_positive: If S1_STATIONARY: a static endpoint denylist built from one window remains valid through the longest tested lag (1800 s) on this pool, so the dead-end policy can adopt a long quantified re-probe interval; the measured DENYLIST_HORIZON becomes the schedulable re-probe interval. If SM_CLASS_CONDITIONAL: the intrinsic-block track keeps a long horizon and the rate-driven track uses TRANSIENT_RECOVERY_HALF_LIFE, licensing POLICY_CLASS_CONDITIONAL_DENYLIST.
product_consequence_negative: If S0_NON_STATIONARY: endpoint access state is non-amortizable on this pool; re-observe before each use and do not cache a static per-endpoint access decision. If SIN_INCONCLUSIVE: no policy change is licensed; the horizon remains unmeasured on this pool/window and the dead-end policy keeps its current re-probe behaviour. Both bound (do not close) the timescale axis of C-WEB-DYNAMICS.

estimated_cost.http_requests_breakdown: 5 sweeps x (57 ambient GETs + 5 stress x 8 load GETs) = 5 x 97 = 485, plus 14 oracle GETs = 499; worst case 700

expected_information_gain: High and decision-changing. This is the first falsification-first measurement on the frozen pool of ENDPOINT access-state persistence across separated windows rather than next-request classification, producing the two quantities the dead-end policy currently assumes: DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT/FALSE_REJECT curves with a DENYLIST_HORIZON, plus class-conditional persistence/half-lives. Either branch changes the product's re-probe policy, and S0 is a POSITIVE change result decoupled from both MI non-significance and the coarse pooled horizon.

The referenced handoff (EXP-PHYSICS-37992957068/handoff.json, sha256 3155fac772e6a64e2a3b13847cf320d6acebb1259ccb9b1c85c51d884513a6d4) is inherited as continuity evidence. director_mandate_trace.requirement_pre_freeze_attainability_cer: satisfied on the frozen 57 (6 stably persistent intrinsic barriers; a live rate-limit recovery and a live rate-limit onset observed); see prereg.md.

scope_boundaries: Credential-free public HTTP GET only; no authentication, JavaScript, DOM, SPA, GraphQL or WebSocket.
One stdlib-HTTP client, one User-Agent, one network egress vantage and one ~35-minute collection window; the source-vantage axis is NOT varied and is a declared scope boundary.
The frozen 57-endpoint universe is used unchanged and is NOT extended; no post-outcome substitution or dropping.
No LLM calls, no browser, no credentials, no numpy dependency.
Persistence and denylist validity are tested only through the frozen intrinsic classifier and the frozen ambient/load probes; the horizon is censored at delta_ref=1800 s.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: All five dispositions are reachable through the frozen metric and decision logic. A fresh pre-freeze branch probe (synthetic worlds only, no Web data; script sha256 in prereg.md) applied the exact plug-in MI + permutation + intrinsic-persistence + rate-transient + state-change logic and produced S1 (stationary plant: MI 0.3365, all intrinsic persistent, no rate transient, no state change), S0 (exchangeable/positive-change plant: INTRINSIC_BREAK true, FA 0.25), SM (class-conditional plant: intrinsic persistent + RATE_TRANSIENT, FA 0.333) and SIN (intrinsic-persistent plant with a single new non-rate block: STATE_CHANGE true but INTRINSIC_BREAK false and RATE_TRANSIENT false). Thresholds are arithmetically attainable (with n_denylisted >= 3, any recovery gives FA >= 0.33 > tau_FA=0.10; the STAT_SIG threshold MI>=0.05 is exceeded by the stationary plant). Precedence cannot mask a branch: S0 precedes S1 and is defined by positive change evidence; S1 does not gate on the coarse pooled horizon; MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reserved for prerequisite/control failure only.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Prerequisites are stdlib Python 3.12 only (numpy is NOT required; the bound parent lib is hashed but not imported) plus live network to the frozen universe and oracle hosts. A fresh pre-freeze census on the full frozen 57 (two cold-GET sweeps, script sha256 in prereg.md) observed the exact classifier live: histogram {BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE:5, TRANSPORT_ERROR:1, OTHER_NONBARRIER:5, CLEAN:46}; 6 stably persistent barriers across the window pair (gitlab.com/users/sign_in, community.cloudflare.com, www.npmjs.com/login, wordpress.com/log-in, www.phpbb.com/community/, community.invisioncommunity.com); and live oracle liveness (httpbin 429 RATE_LIMIT_429, httpbingo 429 RATE_LIMIT_429, httpbin 403 UNAVAILABLE_403, httpbin 200/uuid CLEAN, example.com CLEAN, no-such-host.invalid TRANSPORT_ERROR). The >=3 T0 barrier floor is therefore achievable now, and 6 T0 intrinsic endpoints are certified reachable. EXECUTE re-verifies the hard >=3 T0 barrier floor from its own data (failure is MEASUREMENT_INVALID); intrinsic presence is a reported floor, and if none is present at T0 the intrinsic metrics are null and the frozen no-intrinsic clause applies.

baseline_identifiability.reason: The primary null is non-degenerate and the metric separates the regimes rather than sitting at a ceiling. Fresh calibration on the actual plug-in MI + permutation statistic gave NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE false-positive 0.01 at p=0.20 and 0.03 at p=0.30 (<= 0.05) and PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY power 1.00 at (f_b=0.20,rho=0.80) and 0.95 at (f_b=0.10,rho=0.80) (>= 0.80). B_CONSTANT_USABLE is a distinct floor from B_EXCHANGE: the identity-transfer predictor beats it only when the anchor is informative (MI > 0), and the census shows the anchor is informative (6 barriers, f_b_obs ~ 0.105).
